# Card icons

Local SVGs from Lucide 0.468.0 and Tabler Icons 3.31.0. Lucide files keep their upstream names; Tabler files have a `tabler-` prefix. The original paths are unchanged. SVG `currentColor` strokes are set to `#465d4a` so icons stay readable when embedded as images on the light card faces. The apple uses a gold stroke (`#a0782d`).

- Lucide: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/0.468.0/icons — see LICENSE.lucene.txt (ISC and Feather MIT notices).
- Tabler Icons: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons/tree/v3.31.0/icons/outline — see LICENSE.tabler.txt (MIT).

Cards select these images through their `icon` field, for example `icons/tabler-mushroom.svg`. No remote requests or icon service are required during play.
